html_body:
Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, August 25, 2026 — Kuwait time

Result

Thin day — 3 candidates

A wide net across 20+ searches surfaced plenty of headlines but almost nothing that survived a live IBKR check. Visa's breakout to fresh highs on the heaviest volume of the month is today's cleanest setup — full picture below.

⚠️ Confirm buying power before placing anything below

portfolio.json's cash figure ($542.01) is stale and predates the confirmed GOOG fill (~$110 cost). Estimated real cash is closer to ~$430, and two more GTC buy limits (AXTI $58×2, SPXC $200×0.5 — up to ~$216 more) may still be sitting out there unconfirmed. Every position size below is sized off a conservative $430 base. Check live IBKR buying power first — and run portfolio-manager to resync before stacking new orders on top of unconfirmed pending ones.

~30 distinct tickers surfaced across 20 web searches + IBKR topic scans. 3 cleared all 4 gates (live signal, liquidity/sizing, exclusions, extension check). All 3 are large/mid-cap — no small-cap name held up against live IBKR data today (see cap-size note below). Run stock-analyzer [TICKER] on any name for the full deep dive.

🎯 Momentum Shortlist
#1 — V | Visa Inc. ★★★★☆ (4/5) FINANCIALS LARGE CAP

Signal: Broke out to a fresh 52-week/all-time high ($383.43) on Aug 24 on the heaviest single-day volume of the past month (4.11M shares vs a ~2.5-3.5M average) — 1 trading day ago, held today.

Price: $383.00 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: $3.12B  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — financials (XLF) is this week's leading sector, +5% with 11 record highs in 2026, while tech/industrials/utilities lag.

Why it's interesting: Pure fee-based payment-network revenue, not a lender itself. The breakout printed on the month's heaviest volume and hasn't given back a cent since — about as clean a technical as this scan found, with an obvious invalidation level right below the breakout day's low.

Realistic near-term target: +3-6% over 3-7 trading days — round-number levels since price is now in blue-sky territory with no overhead resistance.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET ~$383 is defensible (breakout is only 1 day old, not extended) — or wait for a dip into $378-380 (top of the prior range, now support) for a tighter stop.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $383.50 · stop-limit trigger $371.50 / limit $370.00 (below Aug 24's low of $372.21, the breakout-day structure) · TP1 sell limit $395.00 · TP2 $405.00 · size ≈0.17 sh ≈ $65 (~15% of $430) · R:R ≈1.0:1 to TP1, ≈1.8:1 to TP2

Event window: no dated catalyst — pure technical breakout.  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — payment-network fee business, does not extend credit itself.  |  Defense/military: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: ~$2 round-trip commission is ~3% of this $65 position — TP1 barely clears cost; TP2 is the position's real profit objective.

Next step: analyze V
#2 — THC | Tenet Healthcare Corp. ★★★★☆ (4/5) HEALTHCARE MID/LARGE CAP

Signal: Grinding uptrend to fresh 13/26/52-week highs (all converge at $282.76) as of Aug 24 — up ~14.6% over the past month, higher lows every week. No single dated catalyst; this is relative-strength leadership, not a gap.

Price: $278.59 (IBKR, pre-market snapshot — today's live move unconfirmed)  |  Avg daily $ vol: $353M  |  RS vs SPY: outperforming — healthcare (XLV) is this week's #1 sector inflow (+4.4%).

Why it's interesting: Hospital/outpatient-surgery operator (USPI) riding the rotation into healthcare, making new highs with higher lows every week this month.

Realistic near-term target: +4-8% over 5-10 trading days — round-number levels, no historical resistance overhead.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET ~$278.60, or wait for a dip into $274-276 (recent higher-low support) for a tighter stop.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $279.00 · stop-limit trigger $273.50 / limit $272.50 (below the Aug 21 low $274.07 and Aug 20 close $272.60 — breaks the current higher-low structure) · TP1 sell limit $290.00 · TP2 $300.00 · size ≈0.23 sh ≈ $64 (~15% of $430) · R:R ≈2.0:1 to TP1, ≈3.8:1 to TP2

Event window: no dated catalyst — relative-strength/rotation trade.  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — hospital and outpatient surgical services, no conventional-insurance or interest-based-lending segment identified.  |  Defense/military: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: live snapshot showed zero session volume/change (pre-market) — confirm today's intraday action is actually moving before entering; softer freshness than V.

Next step: analyze THC
#3 — ROST | Ross Stores, Inc. ★★★☆☆ (3/5) RETAIL LARGE CAP

Signal: Gapped up on a Q2 earnings beat + raised guidance (Aug 21, close $228.99→$239.04, +4.4%), then held and edged to a marginal new high Aug 24 ($241.85) — 2 trading days ago, gap fully intact, no give-back.

Price: $241.40 (IBKR live)  |  Avg daily $ vol: $735M  |  RS vs SPY: post-earnings drift, not tied to this week's specific sector leaders — scored lower on relative strength than V/THC.

Why it's interesting: Textbook large-cap continuation shape this strategy favors — the binary event (earnings) is already behind it, and the gap hasn't faded for 2 sessions. 52-week high ($257) sits ~6.5% above with nothing in between.

Realistic near-term target: +4-6% over 3-7 trading days toward the 52-week high.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET ~$241.40, or wait for a dip into $237-239 (mid-gap) for a better entry.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $241.75 · stop-limit trigger $234.00 / limit $233.00 (below both the Aug 21 post-earnings low $234.49 and Aug 24 low $235.40 — a break back into the pre-earnings gap invalidates the thesis) · TP1 sell limit $250.00 · TP2 $257.00 (52-week high) · size ≈0.27 sh ≈ $65 (~15% of $430) · R:R ≈1.1:1 to TP1, ≈2.0:1 to TP2

Event window: earnings already behind it ✅ — no dated event ahead.  |  Halal: ✅ Verified — off-price apparel/home-goods retailer, clean business activity.  |  Defense/military: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: same ~3% commission drag as above on this position size.

Next step: analyze ROST

Cap-size balance: all 3 survivors are mid/large-cap. Small-cap lanes were run in full (52-week-high lists, bull-flag/cup-handle, insider-buying clusters, short squeeze, gamma squeeze, sector sweeps) but nothing on the small-cap side held up against live IBKR data or had a defined edge today — see cuts below. Not a search bias, just how the tape shook out.

🏆 Today's best setup

V (Visa) — the cleanest technical signal of the scan: a genuine breakout to fresh highs on the month's heaviest volume, in the single most liquid name found today ($3.1B/day), riding this week's strongest sector rotation (financials). Invalidation: a close back below $372.21 (Aug 24's breakout-day low) — that's the stop-limit trigger reference, not a percentage guess.

Cut this run — showing the work

MRNA — FADED: gapped from a Phase 3 melanoma-vaccine win (Aug 19) all the way to a $176.66 high, but has since fallen 21% to $138.75, flat today. Same post-approval sell-the-news fade pattern that produced the CELC and VERA losses. No live upward signal.
QNT — FADED vs live data: search flagged it as today's premarket gainer on its Oracle/Quanta deals, but IBKR shows it trading near its 52-week low ($52.78 vs $86.79 high), up only 1.4% today. Search narrative was stale.
BIDU — WEAK: Uber/Dubai robotaxi launch (Aug 20) barely moved the stock; IBKR shows it down today (-0.8%) and near its 52-week low.
SMCI — STALE: guidance-beat headline is old news; live price is ~40% below its 52-week high and flat/negative today.
OKLO — WEAK: 79% below its 52-week high, only a modest bounce off multi-month lows. Beaten-down basing name, not a momentum setup.
LEU (Centrus Energy) — WEAK: 61% below its 52-week high, modest +1% today, no fresh trigger.
CEG (Constellation Energy) — WEAK: 33% below its 52-week high, flat today (+0.2%). Nuclear/AI-power thesis is real but no live trigger this week.
UEC (Uranium Energy Corp) — WEAK: below even its own 13-week high, modest move (+0.5%), no fresh catalyst.
NVTS (Navitas) — WEAK: 63% below its 52-week high despite a "+91% YTD" headline stat; today's +2% is a bounce off depressed levels, not a breakout.
CRDO (Credo Technology) — WEAK: flat today, 28% below its 52-week high, no fresh trigger despite the AI-networking theme.
JBL, SMTC, PAY, ARGX — ILLIQUID SNAPSHOT: near-zero session volume in the live check (pre-market data only) — couldn't confirm today's move against the search narrative. ARGX is also ~$1,011/share; would need a fresh fractional-sizing look before ever considering.
SOFI — ❌ HARAM: core business includes conventional interest-based consumer lending (personal loans, student loans, mortgages) as a primary revenue line, not incidental.
CRCL (Circle Internet Group) — ❌ HARAM: primary revenue is interest income earned on USDC reserve holdings (T-bills) — an interest-based business model at the core, not incidental.
FCFS (FirstCash Holdings) — ❌ HARAM: pawn lending / interest-based consumer finance is the core business, despite a fresh analyst upgrade.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. This shortlist alone is not enough to enter a trade — it's a first filter; run analyze [TICKER] before sizing anything. Generated Aug 25, 2026 Kuwait time.
